npcs.name: Edmund Pike
npcs.title: Chandler
npcs.greeting: Rope, tar, lamp oil. If it floats or burns, I have it.
npcs.line: A sloop needs spare line. Everyone forgets until the wind is up.
npcs.wares: Rope, tar, lamp oil, tallow, blocks and tackle.

npcs.name: Josiah Mott
npcs.title: Clothier
npcs.greeting: Sailcloth, linen, oilskins. Come in out of the weather.
npcs.line: A dry man is a cheerful man. Oilskins work wonders.
npcs.wares: Sailcloth, linen, oilskin coats and woollen caps.

npcs.name: Tobias Wren
npcs.title: Provisioner
npcs.greeting: Salt pork, dried peas, lime juice. The ship's pantry in one shop.
npcs.line: Plan the voyage by the pantry. Ask any old hand.
npcs.wares: Salt pork, dried peas, lime juice, cheese.

npcs.name: Hartley Brine
npcs.title: Baker
npcs.greeting: Warm loaves, Captain! Still steaming.
npcs.line: Bread today, biscuit for the voyage. A hungry crew is a short crew.
npcs.wares: Loaves, ship's biscuit by the sack, honey cake.

npcs.name: Cedric Marl
npcs.title: Clothier
npcs.greeting: Sailcloth, linen, oilskins. Come in out of the weather.

npcs.wares: Sailcloth, linen, oilskin coats and woollen caps.

npcs.name: Nathaniel Shaw
npcs.title: Sailmaker
npcs.greeting: Need a patch? A new topsail? A seam stitched while you wait?
npcs.line: Canvas is only as good as the stitching. Count the stitches.

npcs.name: Obadiah Fenn
npcs.title: Cooper
npcs.greeting: Barrels! Water, salt pork, rum. All sound as a bell.
npcs.line: A leaking cask has sunk more crews than any storm. Mine do not leak.
npcs.wares: Casks and barrels of every size, hoops and bungs.

npcs.name: Lucas Harrow
npcs.title: Provisioner
npcs.greeting: Salt pork, dried peas, lime juice. The ship's pantry in one shop.
npcs.line: Plan the voyage by the pantry. Ask any old hand.
npcs.wares: Salt pork, dried peas, lime juice, cheese.

npcs.name: Matthias Orne
npcs.title: Smith
npcs.greeting: Mind the sparks. What are we mending?
npcs.line: Nails, hinges, anchor shackles. Every ship is iron held together by wood.

npcs.name: Silvan Drake
npcs.title: Carpenter
npcs.greeting: Planks, pegs and patience. Which do you need?
npcs.line: A hull is only a very big barrel. Treat her like one.

npcs.name: Rupert Hale
npcs.title: Baker
npcs.greeting: Warm loaves, Captain! Still steaming.
npcs.line: Bread today, biscuit for the voyage. A hungry crew is a short crew.
npcs.wares: Loaves, ship's biscuit by the sack, honey cake.

npcs.name: Jasper Lowe
npcs.title: Chandler
npcs.greeting: Rope, tar, lamp oil. If it floats or burns, I have it.
npcs.line: A sloop needs spare line. Everyone forgets until the wind is up.
npcs.wares: Rope, tar, lamp oil, tallow, blocks and tackle.

npcs.name: Hargrave Dunn
npcs.title: Tavernkeeper
npcs.greeting: Welcome to the Anchor and Crown! Soup, ale, and a seat out of the wind.
npcs.line: Sailors talk. I listen. Ask me what I hear.
npcs.wares: Soup, ale, rum and a rumour or two.

npcs.name: Phineas Mott
npcs.title: Innkeeper
npcs.greeting: A bed for the night, Captain? Clean sheets, no fleas, mostly.
npcs.line: Merchants pay for quiet. Captains pay for a view of the harbour.
npcs.wares: Rooms, supper, stabling for nothing, since no one keeps a horse here.

npcs.name: Clerk Edwin Pratt
npcs.title: Customs clerk
npcs.greeting: Customs House. Declare your cargo, Captain, and mind the ink.
npcs.line: Fish pays no duty at Anvil Harbor. Silk and spirits pay plenty.

npcs.name: Broker Silas Wolfe
npcs.title: Exchange broker
npcs.greeting: The Exchange! Where a cargo becomes a rumour, and a rumour becomes a price.
npcs.line: Buy low, sail far, sell high. The sailing is the hard part.

npcs.name: Master Aldous Crane
npcs.title: Treasury clerk
npcs.greeting: The Counting House. Reales weighed, doubloons assayed.
npcs.line: A piece of eight is twenty-seven grams of silver. I have weighed them all.

npcs.name: Steward Hollis Crane
npcs.title: Palace steward
npcs.greeting: The Governor receives no one today. But the harbour is open to all honest captains.
npcs.line: The Governor keeps the harbour peace. The harbour keeps the Governor's table.

npcs.name: Harbourmaster Jeremiah Slade
npcs.title: Harbourmaster
npcs.greeting: Jeremiah Slade, harbourmaster. Berths, tides and troubles: I keep the book.
npcs.line: Anchor where you like inside the buoys, and leave the channel clear. That is the whole law of the water.

npcs.name: Registrar Octavian Pell
npcs.title: Town registrar
npcs.greeting: Town Hall. Births, deeds and bell-times are all written in my books.
npcs.line: The clock is never wrong. The sun, on occasion, is.

npcs.name: Clerk Matthias Orne
npcs.title: Treasury clerk
npcs.greeting: The Harbour Treasury. We count everything twice.
npcs.line: Count it twice, spend it once.

npcs.name: Gate guard
npcs.title: Town watch
npcs.greeting: Halt. State your business. ... Ah, a captain. Pass.
npcs.line: The North Road leads to the wild half of the island. Take water.
